visual_loop.comparison_scope: Deterministic Canvas render, before lossy video encoding

visual_review.scope: Independent deterministic Canvas frame review; no audio-listening claim.
findings: Opening brand and all three gameplay phrases are legible inside the planned phone safe core.
First compact shop sign expands into second larger doors; no observed glyph overlap or cut-text defect in settled frames.
Final brand and CTA remain stable from 25.05 through 26.65 sample times, seal does not obscure title.
Frame 0 and frame 27 are pixel-identical; 2,073,600 pixels compared.
No visible hard cut at reviewed scene/code boundaries. Small raster/texture differences have mean RGB delta below 0.018 on a 0–255 scale across the whole frame.
limitations: Static and temporal boundary sampling supplements, but does not replace, final encoded playback verification.
Safe-core guide is an editorial layout aid; actual app overlays vary by device and placement.

findings: Second 开 enlargement now retains visible paper margin at 20.85 and 20.90.
At 26.76 the next opening brand is suppressed while previous CTA is being cleared; 26.88 cleanly reveals the new opening.
25.05–26.65 stable final brand hold is unchanged.

encoded_review.finding: Opening caption, sign-to-door size progression, final brand and return to opening remain readable after H264 encoding.

limitations: Syllable onsets remain ASR-estimated. Offline HTML verified in a no-network Chromium context with embedded assets; direct file:// navigation is blocked in this cloud browser. Visual looping does not change the original audio fade-out.
